q: Surah 50: The letter Qaaf (Qaaf)

s: the earth is spread out spread out
q: And the earth have We spread out,

s: firm hills are in the earth (flung therein)
q: and have flung firm hills therein,

s: lovely vegetation grows on the earth (of every lovely kind)
q: and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,

s: Surah 50: The letter Qaaf (Qaaf) is revealed at Mecca
q: Revealed at Mecca

s: creation is a first creation (prior to a new creation)
q: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.

s: man is created by Allah
q: We verily created man

s: man has a soul (whose whisperings Allah knows)
q: and We know what his soul whispereth to him,

s: Allah is nearer to man (than his jugular vein)
q: and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

s: the two Receivers receive man (seated on the right hand and on the left)
q: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,

s: death is agony (coming in truth)
q: And the agony of death cometh in truth.

s: the threatened Day is threatened Day
q: This is the threatened Day.

s: every soul comes with a driver
q: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.

s: every soul comes with a witness
q: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.

s: the evil-doer is in heedlessness (before the covering is removed)
q: Thou wast in heedlessness of this.

s: the Glorious Qur'an is a glorious scripture
q: 1 Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,

s: the evil-doer has piercing sight (on the day of judgment)
q: Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.

s: hell receives each rebel ingrate
q: Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,

s: the evil-doer is a rebel ingrate
q: Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,

s: the evil-doer is a hinderer of good
q: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

s: the evil-doer is a transgressor
q: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

s: the evil-doer is a doubter
q: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

s: the evil-doer sets up another god (along with Allah)
q: Who setteth up another god along with Allah.

s: the Garden is brought nigh to the penitent and heedful (no longer distant)
q: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.

s: a warner is a warner (of their own)
q: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them;

s: the penitent and heedful enters the Garden (in peace)
q: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.

s: the Day of immortality is day of immortality
q: This is the day of immortality.

s: the Garden contains all that they desire (with more from Allah)
q: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.

s: the heavens are created by Allah (with the earth and all between them)
q: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days,

s: Allah is not touched by weariness (in creation)
q: and naught of weariness touched Us.

s: the (Awful) Cry is heard in truth (on the day of coming forth)
q: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth.

s: the disbelievers are in troubled case (after denying the truth)
q: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.

s: the (Awful) Cry is the day of coming forth (from the graves)
q: That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

s: Allah quicken and give death every soul
q: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death,

s: the journeying is to Allah
q: and unto Us is the journeying.

s: the gathering is easy for Us (to make)
q: That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

s: Muhammad is not a compeller (over the disbelievers)
q: and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them.

s: Muhammad warns with the Glorious Qur'an (whoever fears Allah's threat)
q: But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.

s: Allah has a warning (proffered to mankind)
q: when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

s: the warning is proffered by Allah (before judgment)
q: when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

s: the earth takes them
q: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.

s: Surah 53: The Star (An-Najm) has title Surah 53: The Star (An-Najm)
